title: Adaptive intrinsic dimension with Mirror view and private residual
hypothesis: On a mixed task bank with known task-to-task variation in intrinsic complexity, validation-selected per-task dimension plus a Mirror angle for a shared-radius first coordinate pair and private higher-dimensional residuals will lower the actual serialized payload by at least 10% versus validation-selected ordinary intrinsic coefficients, while meeting the same held-out quality gate. Tasks outside the orbit must fall back to private intrinsic coordinates.
physical_object: one shared 32D base predictor and a deterministic random orthonormal 32x16 intrinsic basis
mirror_coordinate: one FP16 angle replacing two FP16 coefficients in the first two intrinsic coordinates; FP16 residual coordinates for active dimensions above two; private 16D coefficient fallback if the fixed-radius orbit misses validation
logical_multiplicity: 160 task functions across four orbit-aligned intrinsic complexities plus unrelated 16D functions; task count is not independent capacity
controls: adaptive Mirror angle plus private residual/fallback

task.task_groups: four 32-task aligned groups with true intrinsic dimensions 2,4,8,16; 32 unrelated tasks with random 16D coefficients
task.threshold_selection: development-only; choose the strictest threshold that selects each aligned group's true dimension on both development seeds and keeps mean held-out normalized MSE <=1e-4

development.selection_reason: At threshold 1e-4, both development seeds had group-median selected dimensions 2/4/8/16 for aligned groups, normalized test MSE below 1e-4, and the smallest observed adaptive payload among thresholds meeting the group-median dimension requirement. Mirror exceeded adaptive-direct actual bytes in both development seeds; the preregistered fresh worlds are still run to determine whether that negative storage result replicates.

fresh.access_condition: Only after source, threshold, byte gates, task split, and controls are frozen.

training.optimizer: least-squares fit in a frozen deterministic random intrinsic basis; 720-point angle grid for Mirror first pair

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: deterministic ZIP/NPY arrays with fixed timestamps; all bases used, task dimension/mode indices, offsets, coefficients, shared base, radius, and metadata included
storage.basis_policy: Persist only the maximum active basis prefix required by the method; no hidden reconstruction state.
storage.private_fallback_policy: If no Mirror dimension meets the validation threshold, serialize the full 16D intrinsic coefficient vector and mark the task private.

gates.promising: On every fresh seed, adaptive Mirror mean held-out normalized MSE <=1e-4 and actual serialized bytes <=0.90x adaptive direct coefficients; additionally report dimension allocation, fixed-dimension frontier, and unrelated fallback rate.
gates.fail: Quality misses in >=2 fresh seeds, or Mirror payload is >= adaptive direct payload in >=2 fresh seeds, or aligned tasks need private fallback in >=2 seeds.
gates.not_established: Any split, deterministic replay, or payload serialization check fails.

boundaries: known shared-radius Givens orbit in the first pair

amendments.reason: The original phrase “selects each aligned group’s true dimension” was ambiguous if applied per task; one low-amplitude d=4 task selected d=2 at the strict threshold. It is now operationalized as matching the median selected dimension within each of the four aligned groups on both development seeds. All per-task allocations remain reported. This correction changes no data, fitting rule, or gate.

Corrected active inference operation proxy to use each task’s selected dimension rather than max dimension for all adaptive tasks. Preserved the earlier summary JSON in protocol_variants/pre_active_ops_correction/. Payload bytes and held-out metrics are unchanged.
